description: Bump Chart is a premium Power BI visual designed to help teams easily track and analyze how key metrics, entities, or categories change rank over time. Whether you are monitoring the top-performing products, comparing business units, measuring market shifts, or evaluating competitive performance, this visual provides a clear, intuitive, and engaging way to understand ranking dynamics at a glance. The Bump Chart is ideal for any Power BI user who needs to understand relative performance across time, including: Business analysts and data analysts tracking KPIs across periods Product managers monitoring product rankings, lifecycle performance, and category trends Retail, financial services, and sales teams comparing top sellers, branches, funds, or customer segments Operations and performance managers assessing how units, teams, or assets move up or down in ranking Consultants and analytics leads creating executive dashboards that highlight performance evolution Strategy and insights teams analyzing long-term shifts in competition, demand, or market share If your work involves identifying leaders, laggards, trends, or rank volatility, this visual provides immediate clarity. Bump Chart for Power BI lets you: Present rankings in a clean, intuitive, and interactive visual Automatically calculate ranks over time from any data (e.g., sales, scores, views...)
